query: 如何构建面向智慧情报服务的 benchmark query set 与评测协议？
effective_search_query: 智慧情报服务 benchmark query set 评测协议 构建

major_issues: 报告标题和核心问题聚焦于'智慧情报服务'的基准查询集与评测协议构建，但证据集中缺乏直接针对'智慧情报服务'（intelligence services）benchmark构建的文献。证据[2]讨论的是智慧图书馆，证据[6]讨论自然灾害评估，证据[7]虽提及intelligence services但为2020年综述，均非直接相关。报告将来自不同领域（图书馆、化学、灾害、车联网）的证据外推至'智慧情报服务'这一核心领域，存在领域泛化风险，且未充分论证这种跨领域借鉴的合理性。

报告在'核心主题与证据'和'研究方向'部分提出的多项具体建议（如'意图感知与动态认知建构'、'多轮对话与知识库增量构建'、'多模态数据理解'、'多智能体协作与安全决策'）超出了摘要证据的直接支持范围。证据[2]提到了'意图感知+认知建构+内容生成'的服务模式，但未说明这应如何转化为benchmark查询集；证据[3][4][5][6]描述了各自系统的能力，但未提供将其通用化为benchmark构建方法论的信息。报告从'系统能做什么'过度推断至'benchmark应测什么'，逻辑链条不完整。
报告结论声称'一个可行的框架需要...并设计相应的协议以度量智能体在复杂、动态、协作环境下的综合性能'，但证据[1]仅指出benchmark需要在沙盒与真实服务间权衡，并提出了状态差异评估方法，并未提供构建'综合性能'评测协议的具体指导。证据[5]指出了智能体协作的问题，但未提供评测这些问题的协议方案。因此，结论中关于'可行框架'的表述缺乏足够的证据支撑。
citation_issues: 对证据[1]的引用不准确。报告在'基准评测框架的设计与权衡'和'评测协议与指标设计'中引用[1]，声称其提出了'通过代码执行与基于状态差异的评估'的方法，并暗示其与'任务完成状态的差异评估'指标相关。证据[1]摘要确实提到了'code execution with state-diff-based evaluation'，但报告将其引申为一种可纳入评测协议的通用'度量'方法，而证据[1]摘要并未说明其评估指标的具体构成或如何将其泛化到智慧情报服务领域。
对证据[2]的引用存在过度解读。报告多次引用[2]来支持'智慧情报服务的范式转型'及'查询集应涵盖的交互深度和认知维度'等观点。证据[2]确实描述了智慧图书馆的服务模式转型和'意图感知+认知建构+内容生成'模式，但摘要并未提及任何与benchmark或query set构建相关的内容。报告将'服务模式'直接等同于'benchmark设计方向'，缺乏中间论证。
对证据[8]的引用不相关且牵强。证据[8]研究车联网中的安全卸载与资源分配，采用多智能体深度强化学习方法。报告在'多智能体与知识系统的关键作用'和'研究方向'中引用[8]，将其作为'多智能体协作与安全决策'场景的例子。然而，该研究聚焦于通信与计算资源的优化分配，与'智慧情报服务'的查询理解、信息提取、知识交互等核心任务相去甚远，其方法与结论对回答研究问题的参考价值极低，引用不当。
revision_instructions: 严格限定结论范围，明确区分哪些是从证据摘要中直接得出的观察，哪些是基于证据的推测或延伸思考。在报告开头或结论部分增加显著声明，指出由于证据集中缺乏直接针对'智慧情报服务benchmark构建'的文献，当前分析是基于对相关领域（如软件代理评估、智慧信息系统、多智能体应用）的旁证进行的初步推导，其适用性有待验证。
修正或弱化所有缺乏直接证据支持的、具体的benchmark构建建议。例如，将'查询集构建应涵盖...'等肯定性表述，改为'现有研究表明，在相关领域，系统的能力涵盖...，这提示智慧情报服务的benchmark可能需要考虑...，但具体如何转化为查询任务需进一步研究'。避免从'系统有能力做X'直接跳跃到'benchmark必须测试X'。
重新评估并删减不相关或支持力度极弱的引用，特别是证据[8]。若保留，必须明确说明其与智慧情报服务benchmark构建的关联非常间接，仅作为多智能体技术在某领域应用的遥远参考。检查并修正所有引用表述，确保每处引用都准确反映原文摘要的确切内容，不添加未明确陈述的细节或推论。例如，对于证据[1]，应明确指出其提出的方法（代码执行与状态差异评估）是针对企业API任务的具体方案，摘要未讨论其通用化。
在'摘要级证据的局限'部分，应增加一条：'证据领域分散且不直接对口：所提供的文献均非专门研究智慧情报服务评测体系构建，而是来自软件代理评测、图书馆学、化学信息学、灾害学、车联网等多个领域，将其发现整合并应用于智慧情报服务领域存在外推风险。'

top_papers.title: Agent-Diff: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise API Tasks via Code Execution with State-Diff-Based Evaluation
top_papers.abstract: We present Agent-Diff, a novel benchmarking framework for evaluating agentic Large Language Models (LLMs) on real-world productivity software API tasks via code execution. Agentic LLM performance varies due to differences in models, external tool access, prompt structures, and agentic frameworks. Benchmarks must make fundamental trade-offs between a sandboxed approach that controls for variation in software environments and more ecologically valid approaches employing real services. Agent-Diff attempts to capture the desirable features of both of these approaches by including access to the real API interfaces for software services while sandboxing the environment in which calls are made, processed, and evaluated. top_papers.title: A Multi-Agent System Enables Versatile Information Extraction from the Chemical Literature
top_papers.abstract: To fully expedite AI-powered chemical research, high-quality chemical databases are the foundation. Automatic extraction of chemical information from the literature is essential for constructing reaction databases, but it is currently limited by the multimodality and style variability of chemical information. In this work, we developed a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based multi-agent system for robust and automated chemical information extraction. It utilizes the MLLM's strong reasoning capability to understand the structure of diverse chemical graphics and decompose the extraction task into sub-tasks. top_papers.title: AGENTiGraph: A Multi-Agent Knowledge Graph Framework for Interactive, Domain-Specific LLM Chatbots
top_papers.abstract: AGENTiGraph is a user-friendly, agent-driven system that enables intuitive interaction and management of domain-specific data through the manipulation of knowledge graphs in natural language. It gives non-technical users a complete, visual solution to incrementally build and refine their knowledge bases, allowing multi-round dialogues and dynamic updates without specialized query languages. The flexible design of AGENTiGraph, including intent classification, task planning, and automatic knowledge integration, ensures seamless reasoning between diverse tasks. top_papers.title: Reliable Collaborative Conversational Agent System Based on LLMs and Answer Set Programming
top_papers.abstract: As the Large-Language-Model-driven (LLM-driven) Artificial Intelligence (AI) bots became popular, people realized their strong potential in Task-Oriented Dialogue (TOD). However, bots relying wholly on LLMs are unreliable in their knowledge, and whether they can finally produce a correct outcome for the task is not guaranteed. The collaboration among these agents also remains a challenge, since the necessary information to convey is unclear, and the information transfer is by prompts: unreliable, and malicious knowledge is easy to inject. top_papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) are transforming how geoscientists interact with data, models, and decision-support systems. Beyond literature web search and text processing, LLMs now enable new forms of knowledge discovery, real-time analysis, and human–AI collaboration in natural hazards and climate-risk research. top_papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
top_papers.abstract: The mobile edge computing (MEC) technology can simultaneously provide high-speed computing services for multiple vehicular users (VUs) in vehicular edge computing (VEC) networks. Nevertheless, due to the open feature of the wireless offloading channels and the high mobility of the vehicles, the security and stability of the offloading process would be seriously degraded.
